thread:
incident-bot: PAGER — High GPU pool pressure detected in us-west-2. Autoscaler attempted provisioning 18 instances in last 10m, 12 failures. Observed inference latency SLO violations (p95 > 600ms) for several prod routes. Bridge created: #bridge-2122223333. No active customer-facing error pages reported yet.
anne (oncall): joining bridge. seeing repeated ProvisionFailed errors in autoscaler logs. digging into cloud quota/spot loss.
kevin (infra): looking. cloud console shows transient quota surge limit reached for 'nvidia-a100' in us-west-2. AWS quota soft-limit; multiple teams spiking. Raising support ticket now.
maria (product): which customers hit? need initial customer-impact for CS and support triage.
anne (oncall): quick check: topology shows three customers with >5% 5xx or latency spikes on inference routes: corp-tile, searchlabs, alpha-games. not full outage but degraded latency/throughput for heavy batch requests.
raj (sre): flagging potential regional spillover: autoscaler kept retrying and over-subscribed the thin-provision pool causing eviction churn. mitigation options: 1) temporary regional fallback to eu-west-1; 2) reduce batch_window for heavy routes; 3) force-scale Dedicated reserve if available.
anne (oncall): applied stopgap: forced model fallback on corp-tile to smaller-quantized variant (gpt-medium-q4) for requests >2s. latency improved on that route.
kevin (infra): support ticket created (#AWSSUP-183729). ETA from cloud support unknown. I can temporarily borrow capacity from our Dedicated pool in us-east-1 and route lower-priority traffic there. will coordinate with routing.
maria (product): can we notify impacted customers with ETA? CS wants a succinct impact note.
anne (oncall): drafting note: "We observed elevated inference latency in us-west-2 affecting a subset of requests; mitigation in progress. Temporary model fallbacks applied for high-latency requests. Next update in 30m."
pm-ops: ping — will push notice once we confirm list.
kevin (infra): manual routing change pushed for non-latency-critical traffic: added routing rule to prefer us-east-1 for heavy-batch jobs. command used:
```
rbctl route update --prefix /v1/generate --prefer-region us-east-1 --filter batch_size>32
```
anne (oncall): autoscaler error snippet:
```
2026-03-15T12:04:02Z autoscaler ERROR ProvisionFailed: limitExceeded: QuotaExceeded for nvidia-a100
2026-03-15T12:04:07Z autoscaler WARN RetryProvision(3/5)
```
olivia (runbooks): noting: current capacity-playbook doesn't include a cross-region capacity-borrow step. I'll add a section for "capacity bridge" and a checklist for model fallback rules.
raj (sre): to capture: scheduling a post-incident review. Proposed doc: INF-4091 (postmortem + action item tracker) https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4091 — please create sub-tasks for infra, autoscaler, runbooks.
kevin (infra): assigned myself to infra subtask. initial action: request permanent quota increase for nvidia-a100 in us-west-2 and add quota-usage monitoring alert. due: 2026-03-22.
olivia (runbooks): creating runbook PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runbooks/pull/687 — includes steps: detect quota exhaustion, temporary region borrow, deploy model fallback, and emergency paging criteria.
maria (product): CS note sent to affected customers, included mitigation and ETA for full postmortem. they asked for timeline for recurrence prevention.
anne (oncall): metrics: p95 latency returned to acceptable range for most routes after routing changes and fallback, still observing elevated retry rates for a minority of requests.
pm-ops: can we get an exact count of affected requests? ops dashboard shows ~2.1% of total inference volume in the interval, spike lasted ~45 minutes.
raj (sre): postmortem meeting: Thursday 09:30 PT. Invitees: oncall rotation, infra, autoservices, product, cs, runbook owners. Meeting note owner: raj.
anne (oncall): interim action items captured in thread: 
- kevin: request quota increase + monitor alerts (owner: kevin, due: 2026-03-22)
- olivia: update runbook capacity-bridge section + PR (owner: olivia, due: 2026-03-18)
- raj: postmortem doc + action tracker (owner: raj, due: 2026-03-17)
- anne: customer-impact summary + share in #support (owner: anne, due: 2026-03-16)
- kevin: add thin-provision pool guardrails to prevent eviction-churn (owner: kevin, due: 2026-03-20)

kevin (infra): also adding an autoscaler change: abort provisioning if quota failures exceed 3 attempts in 10m and signal fallback instead of retrying endlessly. will open PR.
olivia (runbooks): runbook checklist draft excerpt:
```
1) Confirm provision-failure reason (quota vs spot preempt)
2) If quota -> request increase + escalate to infra
3) If spot preempt -> trigger fallback model + consider non-spot reservation
4) If prolonged -> apply cross-region borrow (document steps)
```
maria (product): adding customer ask: add a knob to force fallback per-customer while preserving other tenants on full models. filed feature request INF-4205.
raj (sre): linking monitoring graphs in doc: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/GPUPressure/region-us-west-2?from=now-1h
anne (oncall): closing bridge in 2m unless anyone objects — main mitigation in place and no new alerts.
kevin (infra): objection handled, will keep monitoring for 2 more hours.
pm-ops: noted for postmortem: confirm SLA exposure math and communicate to finance if needed.
anne (oncall): final: thanks all — marking this thread for follow-up and will copy action items into INF-4091. :thumbsup:
